For your vessel, scheduled crew change at Singapore anchorage will be postponed until further confirmation.
Port authorities are prioritizing cargo vessels, which may further impact crew logistics.
All sign-off crew must remain onboard until official clearance is granted.
Please ensure all travel documents and handover procedures are completed in advance to avoid further delay once clearance is received.
Kindly monitor updates closely and maintain communication with the local agent.
Best regards,
Fleet Operations
